source_scope: existing pinned S014 financial inputs plus existing stock, market, sector and execution daily inputs only
financial_rules: Use only admitted observation IDs and per-field availability
Quarter=YTD-current minus prior YTD within same year; Q1 directly; all dependencies known by decision
Income.n_income is consolidated profit; never cashflow/net-profit substitution
At same decision timestamp combine all reports and use latest report period for state; preserve older report lineage
No dividend/quarter adjustment using later restated reports
2018Q3 receivables-only diagnostic unavailable; no zero filling

F1.gross_margin_yoy: (quarter_revenue-quarter_cost)/quarter_revenue minus same quarter previous year gross margin; require positive current and reference revenue
F1.flag: revenue_yoy>0 AND gross_margin_yoy>0; strict fixed zero boundaries
F1.control: quarter parent-attributable profit YoY difference>0; no threshold tuning

F2.delta: quality minus same quarter previous year quality
F2.competition: YoY change in accounts_receivable/assets and inventories/assets, descriptive only; do not equate combined receivables and notes

event_universe.entry_population: all financial disclosure clusters, never only former H3 entries or price-selected cohort
event_universe.initial_state: 2019Q3 only for starting state; not another evaluation event

horizon.price_label: E is first SSE session after decision; close at E+19 divided by HFQ open at E minus1
horizon.risk_label: minimum HFQ Low over E..E+19 divided by HFQ Open(E) minus1; negative is worse
horizon.intraday_entry_risk_limit: full-session lows measure forward price excursion, not a post-intraday-fill path certificate
horizon.incremental_return: stock 20-session price label minus sector 20-session label; market counterpart reported
decision_controls: stock trailing20 return at D close
sector trailing20 return at D close
horizon.censoring: Insufficient future sessions unavailable, never dropped silently
horizon.calendar_index: Use actual SSE session index, never20 next nonmissing stock rows. E fixed by SSE, no move to first tradable bar; missing required prices => explicit unavailable.
horizon.dependency_endpoint: max(price_end_date, planned_exit_date, actual_exit_date); no-trade uses planned endpoint; filled but not exited by cutoff uses cutoff and execution unresolved status. Remove2026 sensitivity includes no-trade with complete price path and endpoint<=2025-12-31, excludes unresolved filled positions.

execution_labels.purpose: isolated event execution-feasibility/net-position labels, not continuous strategy accounts or qualification
execution_labels.buy: one DAY limit order at E, SRT frozen rule, previous D raw close +1%, lot100, tick0.01, starting cash100000, fee0.001; no retry of a missed entry
execution_labels.matching: public TXE.resolve_fill and actual SessionPriceLimits with DailyQuote, existing DAILY_RANGE_V3 contract, not a custom matcher or a 30m claim
execution_labels.exit: market after 20 holding sessions, first planned E+20; if suspended/unfilled retain pending and retry subsequent sessions through cutoff
execution_labels.scale: raw prices for order planning, raw-to-HFQ relative factors for post-entry return incl corporate adjustment; disclose HFQ research quantity units vs literal raw-share cash account
execution_labels.cost: buy and sell0.001; lot/cash leftover observed per-event only; no compounding or annual strategy claims
execution_labels.not_filled: preserve no-trade status; do not silently impute a successful trade return

primary_contrasts.definition: F1-positive versus parent-profit-positive control as two declared event selection sets; paired overlap retained and counts disclosed

inference.sampling_unit: disclosure-date event; additionally merge transitively overlapping E..actual/planned E+20 label intervals into dependency blocks
inference.bootstrap_unit: dependency blocks; compare event-weighted and block-equal summaries; missing-group resamples invalid and counted
inference.confidence_intervals: percentile95%, exploratory descriptive; no unregistered economic hard gate or p-value selection
influence: remove top absolute target1 and3 events with deterministic date tie-break
exclude2026 only if both decision and label/actual-exit endpoints <=2025-12-31
inference.no_cherry_pick: all four primary contrasts and controls reported regardless of sign; no alternate windows or threshold grids
inference.estimand: Within common valid price-label and feature population: selected-group arithmetic mean minus complement arithmetic mean for F1_RETURN and both F2 contrasts; F1_VS_PARENT is mean(F1-positive) minus mean(PARENT-positive), overlapping events retained in the same resample. Net filled-position subsets are secondary and never replace the primary sample.
inference.block_equal: For each selection group take its within-block mean, then average across blocks containing that group with equal block weights; group mean difference. Missing group in a block is not zero; both groups entirely absent in a resample => invalid.
inference.unavailable: n=0 or fewer than2 contributing dependence blocks => effect/CI unavailable as applicable; report group events, contributing blocks, total resamples, valid and invalid counts; no fabricated intervals.

fixed_models.purpose: small-sample incremental check, no model/parameter search
fixed_models.fitting: OLS intercept, training-only mean/std scaling of continuous predictors, no regularization tuning
fixed_models.walk_forward: at each event train only events with complete label endpoints strictly before current decision, minimum12 events; rank deficiency or nonfinite data => model unavailable
fixed_models.reporting: all in-sample descriptive coefficients plus paired walk-forward MAE/RMSE; no claiming independent unseen holdout
fixed_models.paired_samples: Each base-versus-augmented pair uses identical complete training rows, identical maturation cutoff and same OOS events; continuous-control scaling on training rows only. Rank-deficient/constant added flag is unavailable; no intercept-only or ridge fallback. Report unavailable-fit counts and not just successful prediction scores.

prior_information: previous feasibility forecast rows may only flag observed prior guidance for same period; absence unknown and not a zero feature, no F3 fit
component_judgment: RSCH classify supported/ineffective/insufficient from direction, increments, concentration and trade-label evidence; diagnostics not new economic acceptance gates
prior_selection_exposure: All S014 history is already seen development data. Source-identity lookup in EX033 inputs exposed old event counts and3 old unmatched entries; not used for financial feature, cohort, threshold or endpoint selection; no new holdout claim.
